screens.title: Inventory
screens.description: A 9-column item matrix with a compact equipment rail, selected-slot treatment, stack counts, and a separate hotbar.

screens.title: Crafting
screens.description: A recipe grid with input slots, a single output slot, and explicit ready, missing, and blocked states.

screens.title: Building Palette
screens.description: A compact block palette grouped by material and use, with swatch, name, and selection state.

limitations: All vector art, block labels, counts, and recipe data are original examples; no Minecraft game assets or official font are included.
This is a Java Edition visual-language study, not a version-specific reproduction or verified interface specification.
No engine integration, gameplay logic, or measured search-demand evidence is included.
